chunks: And if two groups of the believers fight each other, then make peace between them; but if one of them transgresses against the other, fight the one that transgresses until it returns to the command of Allah; then if it returns, make peace between them with justice and be impartial. Verily, Allah loves those who are impartial.
ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ruling on civil war or internal conflict among Muslims?
ai.summary: Known as the Verse of Civil War (Ayat al-Qital), this passage establishes the jurisprudential framework for managing internal strife (fitna) within the Ummah, emphasizing that conflict is a last resort after failed mediation. Shia scholars, particularly in Tafsir al-Mi'qdad and works of the Ahl al-Bayt, highlight the criteria for identifying the 'aggressor' (al-baghī) and the necessity of restoring justice (adl) rather than mere cessation of hostilities. The verse underscores the divine preference for equitable resolution, linking political stability to spiritual obedience.
